confirmationSetPolicy: Do not decode, infer, label, evaluate or tune on the six reserved confirmation songs in E3

model.name: Dance Dance Convolution step-placement CNN ported as ddc_onset
model.runtime: PyTorch CPU, local v560 vendor only

audio.decoder: Electron Web Audio decodeAudioData from original frozen audio

timeMapping.rule: frame i = i*441/44100 seconds = i/100 seconds
timeMapping.derivation: Each FFT is left-padded by half its frame length and zero-phase windowed; feature frame zero is centered at original sample zero and frames advance 441 samples
timeMapping.parabolicInterpolation: On the official smoothed salience around each official peak; delta clipped to [-1,1] frame

methods.full: Frozen v558 adjacent-frame spectral-flux candidate residuals
methods.ddcOfficial: Official ddc_onset find_peaks plus CHALLENGE threshold 0.28875697; no interpolation
methods.ddcParabolic: Same official peaks and threshold, with parabolic subframe interpolation on smoothed salience

candidateMatching: Nearest DDC peak within +/-10 ms around reference + frozen globalDelay + frozen actual cross-fit top2/DP phase; full residual copied from v558

oracleCenterDiagnostic.rule: After joining provisional labels, find nearest DDC peak within +/-20 ms of annotated actual onset; no_clear objects have no oracle-center candidate
oracleCenterDiagnostic.purpose: Separate DDC timing quality from old globalDelay and phase prediction errors

hypotheses.H1: At least one DDC onset representation improves clear+approximate recall over full without reducing precision
hypotheses.H2: Parabolic subframe interpolation improves paired absolute-error diagnostics over official frame quantization
hypotheses.H3: Official short-fixture features, scores, exact peak counts and direct 100 Hz time mapping can be validated before real-song candidates are revealed

testPolicy: No threshold, difficulty, timing offset, phase, smoothing or feature retuning after real-song metrics are revealed; any change requires a new version and independent confirmation set
